description: This file defines an enum 'SmsCampaignStatus' which represents different statuses of an SMS campaign within the system. It includes status codes, string identifiers, a constructor, and a static method to get enum instance from an integer value.

classes.name: SmsCampaignStatus
classes.description: Enum representing different statuses (INVALID, PENDING, ACTIVE, CLOSED) of SMS campaigns with associated integer codes and string identifiers.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method to map an integer status value to its corresponding SmsCampaignStatus enum instance.
